summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares executed 12–16 October 2026 through Goldman Sachs International, held in treasury. The company bought 399,172 shares on Nasdaq/other US venues and 997,276 shares on the London Stock Exchange and other UK venues; the London purchases averaged roughly GBP 8.38–9.20 and US purchases USD 11.21–12.22 per share. The activity sits under the buyback announced 21 July 2026, authorizing up to GBP 405 million (about $540 million) of Class A shares. Watch execution pace against the authorization and any price-sensitive trading blackout windows.
